workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, I've checked Priya's and Marcus's calendars. Here are the 30-minute slots they have free for the meeting next week:
Mon Nov 16: 09:00, 09:30
Tue Nov 17: 13:00, 13:30, 16:30
Wed Nov 18: 15:00, 15:30
Thu Nov 19: 10:00
Fri Nov 20: 11:00, 11:30

Please check these times against Elena's and David's calendars and let me know which ones work for them.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked Elena's and David's calendars. Unfortunately, none of the times you proposed work for them.

Instead of going back and forth, I've compiled a full list of all the 30-minute slots where both Elena and David are free next week. Please compare this with your list and find a match.

Mon Nov 16: 11:00, 11:30
Tue Nov 17: 09:00, 09:30
Wed Nov 18: 13:00, 13:30
Thu Nov 19: 09:30, 14:30, 15:00
Fri Nov 20: 15:00, 15:30

Let me know which one works so I can send the confirmation.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Hi Brad, thanks for checking. I've compared our lists, and it looks like there are no times that work for all four partners.

To avoid more back and forth, how about you send me the full list of Elena's busy times? I'll then find the times that work for Priya, Marcus, and Elena. I can send that shorter list to you, and you'll only have to check it against David's calendar. Let me know if that works for you.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, that's a good plan. It's a systematic way to find the slot. Here are Elena's busy times for next week:

Mon: 09:00-10:00, 10:30-11:00, 12:00-17:00
Tue: 10:00-11:00, 12:00-14:00, 14:30-17:00
Wed: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-12:00, 12:30-13:00, 14:00-15:00, 15:30-17:00
Thu: 09:00-09:30, 10:00-14:00, 15:30-17:00
Fri: 09:00-10:30, 11:00-13:00, 13:30-15:00, 16:00-17:00

Let me know what you find, and I'll check the times against David's calendar.

workspace.author: Alison
workspace.text:
Thanks, Brad. I've cross-referenced Elena's schedule with Priya's and Marcus's.

It looks like the only time all three of them are available is Wednesday, November 18, at 15:00.

Can you please check if that time works for David? If it does, I'll create the booking.

workspace.author: Brad
workspace.text:
Hi Alison, I've checked David's calendar. Unfortunately, he is also busy on Wednesday, November 18, at 15:00.

Since that was the only time that worked for Priya, Marcus, and Elena, it appears there are no 30-minute slots available for all four partners next week.

I believe our next step is to report that the meeting is infeasible. Please let me know if you agree.
